hosts.description: List of console hosts to manage; each entry specifies connection details to a console server.

name.description: Unique name for this console host (used as identifier in consoletty commands).

aliases.description: Optional list of alternate names for this host.

console_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the console server to connect to.

port.description: Port on the console server (typically 3038 for conserver).

password.description: Password for console server authentication (leave blank if using key-based auth or not required).

username.description: Username for console server authentication (if required).

readonly.description: If true, only permit read access (prevent input).

compression.description: Enable/disable data compression for the connection.

retrydelay.description: Seconds to wait between connection retries.

ports.description: Optional per-port configuration overrides (e.g., for hosts with multiple console ports).

port.description: Console port number on the console server.

password.description: Optional password override for this specific port.

defaults.description: Global default settings applied to all hosts unless overridden.
